I was actually born and raised in Tillamook. These people mention tourism... Well it's not the stink that'll kill that (remember Tillamook is inland) it's the shift to higher intensity dairy farming. When I go back to visit I see no cows in the fields, just scraggly feed corn growing where once was a picturesque scene of cows in vivid green fields. Now that's pretty much gone. There's nothing left for a tourist except gas and groceries as they move on to parks and towns on the coast. It really is shocking how fast things changed...

I really think the whole county should be involved, world famous Tillamook Cheese and all that, you can't let a handful of farmers ruin the most important thing the area has going for it in an effort to cheapen their unique brand just to sell a few more pounds of cheese.
